<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> are craft-able crafting resources, made in the [[furnace II]] onwards. They have a very limited usefulness, only being utilized during the construction of a few late-game workstations.

Conversely, while wasteful, these are one of the earliest sources of unlimited {{Techpoint|Blue|Blue Tech Points}}.
